help: A CLI for interacting with Zotero libraries via Pyzotero.
Manage Zotero items.
List items in the Zotero library.
Retrieve one or more specific Zotero items by their key or ID.
Get child items of a specific Zotero item.
Get the total count of items in the library.
Get item version information.
Create new Zotero item(s).
Update an existing Zotero item.
Delete one or more Zotero items.
Add one or more tags to a Zotero item.
Create Zotero item(s) from DOI metadata.
Get bibliography entries for one or more Zotero items (output is HTML).
Get citation entries for one or more Zotero items (output is HTML).
List deleted items. Requires the --since parameter.
Manage Zotero collections.
List collections in the Zotero library.
Retrieve a specific Zotero collection.
List subcollections of a specific collection.
List all collections and subcollections, flattened.
List items in a specific collection.
Get the count of items in a specific collection.
Get collection version information.
Create one or more new Zotero collections.
Update an existing Zotero collection.
Delete one or more Zotero collections.
Add item(s) to a collection by modifying the item's 'collections' field.
Remove item(s) from a collection by modifying the item's 'collections' field.
Get tags for items in a given collection.
Manage Zotero tags.
List all tags in the library.
List tags for a specific item.
Delete tag(s) from the library.
Commands for managing Zotero file attachments.
Download a file attachment.
Upload file(s) as new attachment(s).
Upload files in batch based on a JSON manifest.
Commands for Zotero searches and saved searches.
List saved searches metadata.
Create a new saved search.
Delete one or more saved searches by their keys.
Commands for working with Zotero full-text content.
Retrieve full-text content for a specific attachment item.
List items with new full-text content since a specific library version.

Set full-text data for an attachment item.
Payload should be JSON: e.g., '{"content": "...", "indexedPages": 50, "totalPages": 50}'
or for text docs: '{"content": "...", "indexedChars": 1000, "totalChars": 1000}'.
Commands for interacting with Zotero groups.

List groups the API key has access to.

Note: Not all common options (e.g., query, filter-tag, filter-item-type, since) 
are directly supported by the underlying PyZotero 'groups()' method.
They are included for CLI consistency if a future version of PyZotero or a 
different internal method supports them for groups.
Currently, 'limit', 'start', 'sort', and 'direction' are the primary passthrough parameters.
Utility and informational commands.
Display API key permissions.
Get the library's last modified version.
List all available item types.
List all available item fields.
List fields for a specific item type.
Generate an item template (for item create).
Manage zot-cli configuration profiles.
Interactive wizard to set up or modify a profile.
Set a specific configuration value for a profile.
Get a specific configuration value from a profile.
List available configuration profiles.
Get or set the active default profile.
